mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past two months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap and economic stagnation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with economic stagnation.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the past month signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month, it signals a tightening labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1%, or low FEDFUNDS does not correlate with accommodative monetary policy.
